SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 697/14/X Date December 18 /2 38）

Subject "Skylark" Broadcasting Station (XQHG) K.C.1300
commenced broadcasting.
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by W Logan A.S.P.

With reference to Special Branch reports dated
8-12-38 and 12-12-38, on the subject of the above station
which, it is stated belongs to Mr. F.W. Wettengel,
adopting the same wavelength as the Swiss owned
Liang Yue Station (XQCT) i.e., K.C.1300, the "Skylark"
Station was formally declared open on 16-12-38, as per
attached translation of an advertisement which appeared
in the Sin Wan Pao issue dated 16-12-38.

The usual guarantee has not been obtained
from this station as it is impossible to accept it in
view of the fact that it has adopted the same wavelength
as the Liang Yue Station. It has been learned that
certain persons connected with the Liang Yue Station
were able to prevail upon the Chinese contractor who
installed the "Skylark" Station equipment to adjust the
machine in such a way as to shift the central point of
the wavelength some 3 Kilocycles to one side of K.C.1300
thus making it possible for both stations to broadcast
simultaneously with the minimum of interference.

（左侧手写批注：

（印：档案号 上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科登记处 编号 S. B. D. 697/14/X 日期 1938年12月18日 /2 38）

事由：“云雀”广播电台 (XQHG) 千周1300
开始广播。
由副督察长 Logan 制作，经助理警务处长 W Logan 转呈。

参照日期为1938年12月8日和1938年12月12日的特别科报告，关于上述电台事宜，据悉该台属于 F.W. Wettengel 先生所有，采用与瑞士人所有的良月电台 (XQCT) 相同的波长，即千周1300，“云雀”电台已于1938年12月16日正式宣布开业，详见随附的刊登于1938年12月16日《新闻报》上的广告译文。

本台未获得通常所需的保证书，因为鉴于其采用了与良月电台相同的波长，无法予以接受。据悉，与良月电台有关的某些人士说服了安装“云雀”电台设备的中国承包商，对机器进行调整，将波长的中心点向千周1300的一侧偏移约3千周，从而使两个电台能够同时广播，并将干扰降至最低。

（左侧手写批注：
J
1938年12月19日。
DBR

P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
）

W Logan
副督察长。

特别科科长

Date Dec. 12, 1938.

Subject Letter from Mr.F.W. Wettengel (German) announcing "Skylark"
Broadcasting Station (Tien Zeur) (XQHG) K.C.1300
established at 701 Foochow Road.

Made by D.S.I. Logan    Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.U

Reference the attached letter, dated December 7,
1938 addressed by Mr. F.W. Wettengel (German), Room 2A, 24
The Bund, announcing the establishment of the "Skylark"
Broadcasting Station (X.Q.H.G.) K.C.1300, at 701 Foochow
Road, this Station is the subject of Special Branch reports
dated, December 8; November 21; and November 5 and is also
mentioned in a letter dated December 6, 1938 addressed to
the Police Department, Shanghai Municipal Council, by Major
Kazuwo Asano, of the Broadcasting Superintendence Office,
it being variously referred to as the Tien Zeur (天蟾 )
and Tien Chuan (天蟾 ) Station. As mentioned in the
reports referred to above, K.C.1300 was adopted as the
frequency wavelength of the Liang Yue Station (X.Q.C.T.)
which is owned by Mr. J.V. Saunier (Swiss) before anything
was heard of Mr. Wettengel or his "Skylark" Station either
from the latter or from the Japanese Broadcasting Superin-
tendence Office.

Mr. Wettengel was interviewed at Headquarters on
December 12, 1938, when he stated that he applied to the
Japanese for permission to use K.C.1300 before Mr. Saunier's
Station was established and that he was assured by the
Japanese that there was no reason why he should apply to
the Police until after his station had been examined and
approved by the Japanese who would issue a permit to him.
It was pointed out to Mr. Wettengel that Mr. Saunier's
Station had been established for some time before any
intimation concerning his, Mr. Wettengel's, Station was
received by the Police.

报告
日期 1938年12月12日。

事由 F.W. Wettengel 先生（德籍）来信宣布“云雀”
广播电台 (Tien Zeur) (XQHG) 千周1300
已在福州路701号成立。

由副督察长 Logan 制作    经 C. Crawford. D.U 转呈。

参照随附的1938年12月7日由 F.W. Wettengel 先生（德籍，地址：外滩24号2A室）发出的信件，宣布在福州路701号成立“云雀”广播电台 (X.Q.H.G.) 千周1300，该电台是日期为12月8日、11月21日和11月5日的特别科报告的主题，并在广播监理处浅野一雄（Kazuwo Asano）少校于1938年12月6日致上海公共租界工部局警务处的信中提及，该电台被分别称为天蟾 (Tien Zeur) 和天蟾 (Tien Chuan) 电台。如上述报告中所述，在从 Wettengel 先生或其“云雀”电台方面，或从日本广播监理处方面听到任何消息之前，千周1300已被采纳为 J.V. Saunier 先生（瑞士籍）所有的良月电台 (X.Q.C.T.) 的频率波长。

Wettengel 先生于1938年12月12日在总部接受了问询，当时他表示，他在 Saunier 先生的电台成立之前就向日本人申请使用千周1300，并且日本人向他保证，在他的电台经过日本人检查并批准并发放许可证之前，他没有理由向警方提出申请。已向 Wettengel 先生指出，在警方收到有关他（Wettengel 先生）电台的任何通知之前，Saunier 先生的电台已经成立了一段时间。

A copy of the guarantee which new stations are
required to furnish, which provides that such new station
must not obtrude on an established wavelength, was handed
to Mr. Wettengel for his information. After perusing
the document, Mr. Wettengel replied that he was unaware
that such a guarantee was necessary but that having
learned of such a prerequisite, he intended to take the
matter up with the Japanese with a view to arriving at
a solution.
